meta.name: data-pipeline
meta.description: Design, build, or debug data processing pipelines. Use when asked to process a dataset, transform data, build an ETL pipeline, schedule batch jobs, or fix data quality issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计、构建或调试数据处理流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理数据集、转换数据或修复数据质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Design, build, or debug data processing pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to process datasets, transform data, or fix data quality issues

howto.what: Claude会按照数据管道最佳实践处理数据：先定义输入输出模式，在边界验证数据，确保管道可重复运行，记录进度，先测试后全量运行，并报告统计信息。
howto.when: 当你要求处理数据集、转换数据、构建ETL管道、安排批处理作业或修复数据质量问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个ETL管道，处理用户点击数据。
say.note: Claude会定义输入输出模式，并生成验证代码。

say.text: 验证这个CSV文件的数据质量。
say.note: Claude会检查数据模式并报告无效记录。

say.text: 调试我的数据管道，找出错误记录。
say.note: Claude会分析日志并建议修复。

howto.what_en: Claude follows data pipeline best practices: defines input/output schemas, validates at boundaries, ensures idempotency, logs progress, tests on sample then full dataset, and reports statistics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to process a dataset, transform data, build an ETL pipeline, schedule batch jobs, or fix data quality issues.

say_en.text: Design an ETL pipeline for user click data.
say_en.note: Claude defines schemas and generates validation code.

say_en.text: Validate the data quality of this CSV file.
say_en.note: Claude checks schemas and reports invalid records.

say_en.text: Debug my data pipeline and find error records.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes logs and suggests fixes.
